items.title: Pete Davidson's Ex Elsie Hewitt Shares Hilarious 'Coparenting' Video
items.summary:
Pete Davidson and ex Elsie Hewitt reunited on Thanksgiving in honor of their 11-month old daughter, Scottie.

“OK, we’re driving through [New] Jersey right now, and it smells so bad,” Hewitt, 30, said in a Thursday, November 26, TikTok video, in which Davidson, 33, drove a car at night. “What did you have to say?”

Covering her mouth and nose with a scarf, Hewitt panned the camera to the comedian.

“You asked me if I farted, and I said, ‘I know, and I know it’s not me because I don’t like it,’” the Saturday Night Live alum added with a laugh, prompting Hewitt to similarly burst into laughter.

The Meaning Behind Pete Davidson and Elsie Hewitt’s Baby Girl’s Name Revealed 

Hewitt captioned her upload, “Coparenting.”

Davidson and Hewitt welcomed their daughter in December 2025, just months before they called it quits on their romantic relationship.

“We are cooperatively coparenting our daughter whose well-being remains our top priority,” the now-exes told Us in a July statement . “We are fully committed to working together to give her love from both of us.”

Davidson, who also reunited with Hewitt to celebrate Scottie’s first Halloween last month, has found his perspective shifted since becoming a parent.

“Scottie is my whole life,” he told Variety in a September profile. “I was living or dying on this business and what I thought people thought of me. It was all validation and ‘If I do this, then I’ll do that.’ But as soon as I saw her for the first time, I was like, ‘Oh my God, none of this f***in’ matters at all. It’s a job. If I get to do cool stuff, great; if not,…

items.title: Kate Middleton Calls Cancer 'A Lonely Road,' Found Solace in Other Patients
items.summary:
Princess Kate Middleton is opening about her cancer battle in her forthcoming documentary, Heal .

“Navigating cancer or any long-term illness is a lonely road,” Kate, 44, said in a new clip from the movie, released Friday, November 27. “But, it’s clear we’re not meant to carry life’s challenges alone. You know, my illness has brought me alongside so many others navigating their own journeys too.”

The Princess of Wales was diagnosed with an undisclosed form of cancer in early 2024. After undergoing a preventive round of chemotherapy, Kate announced in January 2025 that she is in remission . Kate later revealed earlier this month that she will star in a new documentary about her experience.

“This has become so much more than a personal or solitary experience, but really a collective one,” she said in the Friday footage, in which she met with a group of other cancer patients. “Genuinely, meeting you all here today really means a lot to me because it’s lovely to share my own personal experience, but also hear your stories and be able to connect with others who’ve gone through something similar.”

Kate Middleton's Candid Quotes About Cancer Recovery: 'It Will Take Time' 

Speaking to the local British cancer support group, Kate added, “I haven’t really explored this outside of my family walls, really, so thank you for allowing me the time to do that and the open space to explore. I really appreciate that.”

Heal also follows Kate’s Three Peaks Challenge from this summer, in which she tackled the mountaineering feat across England, Wales and Scotland to raise awareness for…
items.t: Kate Middleton Calls Cancer 'A Lonely Road,' Found Solace in Other Patients

items.title: Bears' Colston Loveland Breaks His Silence After Tearful Injury Against Lions
items.summary:
Chicago Bears tight end Colston Loveland shared a hopeful message after he suffered an emotional knee injury against the Detroit Lions on Thanksgiving.  

Loveland, 22, posted a Bible verse via his Instagram Story on Friday, November 27, reading, “You will keep in perfect peace all who trust in you, all whose thoughts are fixed on you!” 

Hours before, Loveland was carted off the field during the first quarter of the Bears’ 39-35 win over the Lions on Thursday, November 26.  

“He was in tears, he was frustrated, and he is officially out with a knee injury,” CBS sideline reporter Tracy Wolfson said on the broadcast. 

Taylor Swift Seemingly Skips Chiefs' Thanksgiving Day Game Against Bills 

Loveland will undergo tests on his left knee on Friday in an attempt to assess the severity of the injury, according to ESPN . 

Bears head coach Ben Johnson did not have an update about Loveland’s condition after the game.  

“Nope, don’t know yet, no,” Johnson, 40, told reporters. “We’ll find out.” 

Loveland, the 10th overall pick by the Bears in the 2025 NFL Draft, had started in all 11 of the Bears’ games this season. The University of Michigan grad has 41 receptions for 397 yards and three touchdowns.

items.title: 'S.W.A.T.' EP Reveals How Long Spinoff Will Run After Changes, Cancellations
items.summary:
S.W.A.T. Exiles has already been renewed, but how long can it run after the original show went through multiple changes and cancellations?

“I’m so day-to-day in it that all I know is that I have more stories I can tell for the foreseeable future that I could even foresee,” showrunner Jason Ning exclusively told Us after the Friday, November 27, finale. “So, I’m not even thinking beyond tomorrow’s episodes, let alone beyond that.”

S.W.A.T. , which premiered on CBS in 2017, followed a police Special Weapons and Tactics (SWAT) team named Twenty Squad that operated in Los Angeles. The procedural faced its fair share of battles to remain on the air when CBS picked up S.W.A.T. for a seventh and final season. The network ultimately reversed that decision due to strong ratings in addition to viewer demand, and S.W.A.T. returned for season 8.

But the celebration didn’t last long ; the network canceled the show for a second time in March 2025. S.W.A.T. seemingly came to an end two months later when the series finale aired on CBS. Days later, however, Sony Pictures Television picked up a spinoff titled S.W.A.T. Exiles , which stars Shemar Moore , who publicly campaigned for the show’s comeback, and a new SWAT unit.

Shemar Moore's Shocking 'S.W.A.T' Spinoff Drama Explained Amid Cast Backlash 

Viewers were surprised that Moore’s character, Daniel “Hondo” Harrelson, was initially the only one returning after the entire cast participated in efforts to bring S.W.A.T. back. (Several alums later made appearances in season 1.)

“Initially, when I was approached by Sony about the…

items.title: Maura Higgins Reveals What She Gave DWTS' Mark Ballas After Season 35 Loss
items.summary:
Maura Higgins promised to give Mark Ballas a Birkin bag if they won season 35 of Dancing With the Stars — so what did her partner receive after their loss?

Higgins, 36, took to Instagram on Wednesday, November 25, to show the Rolex watch she bought for Ballas, 40, after they placed fifth in the competition show.

“I think he’ll survive,” Higgins wrote over a photo of Ballas holding the watch. “A massive thank you for all your time, patience and belief in me. Something I’ll forever be grateful for.”

The reality star previously spoke about rewarding Ballas after their partnership. 

Maura Higgins Expected to Be Eliminated From 'DWTS' Before Semifinals 

“You know, I’ve done well on every show, but I’ve just never got the win,” she recently told Entertainment Tonight, referencing her previous stints on Love Island and The Traitors. “I told Mark that if we win, I’ll get him a Birkin. But only if we win. If we don’t win, he gets nothing.”

Making it to the finale came as a surprise to Higgins after she initially expected to be eliminated early, telling Us earlier this month, “I was definitely in shock. I really wasn’t expecting my name to be called [for the semifinals].”

She continued: “I was expecting to get booted out. I really was. I don’t know why. You know when you have that gut feeling? But then I say this, but my gut is never right. Like, look at me in The Traitors, so I don’t know why I listen to it.”

Higgins’ time on DWTS came with its fair share of highs and lows.

items.title: Jordan Rodgers Calls Brother Aaron's Steelers Departure 'Sad to See'

He continued, “There was so much good vibes and hope about the reuniting of [Mike] McCarthy and Rodgers and the potential to make a playoff run one last dance. Unfortunately, it didn’t happen that way.”
